name: Claude Agent SDK
note: Claude Code's loop as a library
summary: Anthropic's library that exposes Claude Code's agent loop, built-in tools and context management to Python and TypeScript programs. It runs the Claude Code binary and inherits its hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, skills and plugins. It was previously called the Claude Code SDK.
facts: CLAUDE.md and .claude/ config, same as Claude Code
goodFor: Embedding a coding-capable agent in your own app
Reusing Claude Code skills, hooks and plugins
watchOut: Third-party products may not offer claude.ai login without approval
